    freshness [knowledge_lite]: unavailable

    freshness [deception_lite]: loopback-only
        the functional layer exists and reaches only this host: decoys start and listen, and only on private Unix sockets in the runtime's own directory. Nothing outside this host can reach one: the one module that can bind an address (decoy_listener, #196 P1) is called only by the decoy daemon az-decoyd, whose unit is never granted in this build, so no hostile party can be observed by it yet (Nexus#69). This is an embedded feature that really runs and that nothing outside this host can be affected by, which is not the capability being supplied, and is not the same fact as an external peer being absent. The runtime itself reports: no decoy catalogue is present; nothing is approved
    cognition_route [mio]: CORE ONLY; remote M.I.O. disabled; local M.I.O. control-plane-only
        the control plane is implemented and the functional layer is not: the Core reserve is unmeasured (HG-05), so the resource gate refuses every local model provider and none is ever admitted (Nexus#68). This is an embedded feature that cannot supply its capability, which is not the same fact as an external peer being absent | no local model provider is declared; deterministic explanations continue unchanged | resource: envelope 'diagnostic'; headroom undecidable because the Core reserve is unmeasured for Nexus (docs/hardware-gates.md HG-05).
